usedDriverKeys: You unlock it with the driver's own keys.
needLockpick: You need a lockpick to hotwire a car.
hotwired: You hotwire the car and pocket the \I[{icon}]{item}.
ramKilled: {name} goes under the wheels and does not get up.
ramAngered: {name} picks itself up and comes for you.
vehicleScuffed: Something gives way against the front. Damaged: {parts}.
vehicleCrashed: You crash into another vehicle. Damaged: {parts}.
emptyWorldUnlocked: The door is unlocked. Whoever left it here was not coming back for it.

driverSave.nearMiss: [Driver DEX save: {roll}{mod}={total}] Near miss, swerved in time!
driverSave.failed: [Driver DEX save: {roll}{mod}={total} vs DC {dc}] Reflex save failed, the vehicle hits!

incident.hitParty1: Watch where you walk! That is a road!
incident.hitParty2: You came out of nowhere. Are you hurt?
incident.crashParty1: Look at my car! Do you know what that costs?
incident.crashParty2: Where did you learn to drive, a fairground?
incident.hitPerson1: They stepped right out in front of me!
incident.hitPerson2: Oh no. Somebody call for help!
incident.hitCreature1: Something went under the wheels. Is it dead?
incident.hitCreature2: That thing just ran across the road!
incident.fender2: Did you not see me braking?
incident.theft2: Thief! Somebody stop them, they took my car!

hitAndRun: The car does not even slow down. It is gone before you get up.

hitRemark.default1: You went down hard back there. Are you all right?
hitRemark.default2: Next time look both ways. You could have been killed.
hitRemark.Nervous1: Oh no, oh no, are you hurt? I did not see you, I swear I did not see you!
hitRemark.Nervous2: Please tell me nothing is broken. My hands will not stop shaking.
hitRemark.Calm1: Take a breath. Can you stand? Good. Nothing seems broken.
hitRemark.Calm2: That was a nasty knock. Sit a moment before you walk anywhere.
hitRemark.Aggressive1: Are you blind? You walked straight into my bumper, idiot!
hitRemark.Aggressive2: If there is a scratch on that car, you are paying for it.
hitRemark.Melancholic1: Of course it was me who hit somebody. Of course. Are you hurt?
hitRemark.Melancholic2: Everything I touch goes wrong. I am sorry. Truly.
hitRemark.Sanguine1: Up you get! Nothing a hot meal will not fix, eh? You gave me a fright.
hitRemark.Sanguine2: You bounced like a rubber ball! Seriously though, are you fine?
hitRemark.Cautious1: Do not move too fast. Wiggle your fingers first. Then your toes.
hitRemark.Cautious2: I was under the limit, you know. I always am. Are you hurt?
hitRemark.Impulsive1: I slammed the brakes and you still went flying! Wild! You good?
hitRemark.Impulsive2: Right, hop in, I will drive you to a doctor. No? Suit yourself!
hitRemark.Stoic1: You are standing. That is enough. Watch the road from now on.
hitRemark.Stoic2: Pain passes. Mind where you step.
hitRemark.Paranoid1: You jumped in front of me on purpose. Who sent you?
hitRemark.Paranoid2: I know this trick. You fall, then a lawyer appears. Not today.
hitRemark.Empathetic1: I am so sorry. Let me look at you. Does it hurt anywhere?
hitRemark.Empathetic2: I felt that hit in my own bones. Please, tell me you are fine.
hitRemark.Authoritative1: Pedestrians cross at the lines. You did not. Are you injured?
hitRemark.Authoritative2: Stand still and let me check you. Then we will talk about the rules.
hitRemark.Scholarly1: At that speed the impact should not have broken anything. Should not.
hitRemark.Scholarly2: Fascinating trajectory. Terrible for you, of course. Any dizziness?
hitRemark.Artistic1: You fell like a painting tipping off a wall. Are you all right?
hitRemark.Artistic2: I will dream of that thud tonight. Please say you are not hurt.
hitRemark.Adventurous1: Ha! Shake it off, friend. I have had worse falls off a horse.
hitRemark.Adventurous2: That will be a story for the tavern. Still in one piece?
hitRemark.Nurturing1: Oh, sweetheart, come here. Let me see that knee.
hitRemark.Nurturing2: Sit, sit. I have water in the car. Drink something.
hitRemark.Mischievous1: Ten points for the landing! Come on, you are fine, admit it.
hitRemark.Mischievous2: If anyone asks, you tripped. Deal? You look fine anyway.
hitRemark.Cynical1: Great. Now you will sue me. Go on, tell me how hurt you are.
hitRemark.Cynical2: Nobody looks at the road anymore. Then they act surprised.
hitRemark.Disciplined1: I braked in time. Your fault entirely. Are you injured, yes or no?
hitRemark.Disciplined2: Stand up straight. Report anything that hurts.
hitRemark.Fatalistic1: If it was meant to end you, it would have. You are still here.
hitRemark.Fatalistic2: The road takes who it wants. Today it did not want you.
hitRemark.Grumpy1: Of all the roads in the world you picked mine. Wonderful.
hitRemark.Grumpy2: Get out of the street before you make me late twice.
hitRemark.Loyal1: I stopped. I always stop. Are you all right? I will stay till you are.
hitRemark.Loyal2: I will not leave you on the tarmac. Lean on me if you need.
hitRemark.Brave1: I stopped because that is what you do. Need a hand up?
hitRemark.Brave2: Shake it off. If something is broken, I will carry you myself.
hitRemark.Timid1: S-sorry. So sorry. Are you... are you all right?
hitRemark.Timid2: Please do not shout. I did not mean it. Are you hurt?
hitRemark.Hedonistic1: You spilled my coffee all over the seat. Oh, and are you fine?
hitRemark.Hedonistic2: Ruined my whole afternoon. Still, you look alive enough.
hitRemark.Apathetic1: You are alive. Fine. I have places to be.
hitRemark.Apathetic2: Whatever. Watch the road next time.
